name: Tutorial Crust
subtitle: Standard tier: 5%
intro: Welcome, intern. A book club ordered pizza. Standard tier gets 5%. Even you can do this. Probably.

name: Gold Rush Pepperoni
subtitle: Gold tier: 10%
intro: Big Tony is Gold. Gold means 10%. Three days late is fine. Do NOT make eye contact.

name: The Strategic Supreme
subtitle: Strategic tier: 15%
intro: Strategic customers get 15%. These are goats. Strategic goats. Don't ask.

name: Overdue Abyss
subtitle: More than 30 days late = 0%
intro: The Mayor is 45 days late. More than 30 days overdue gets ZERO. I don't care about his title.

name: The Day 30 Trap
subtitle: Exactly 30 days. Think.
intro: Big Tony again. Exactly 30 days late. The rule says MORE than 30. Read the rule. Read it again.

name: The Manager's Blessing
subtitle: Approved exceptions
intro: The dentists are 62 days late, but I signed an exception. I was tired. An approved exception keeps their rate.

name: BOSS: The $25,000 Ceiling
subtitle: No discount above $25k. Ever.
intro: THE GALACTIC PIZZA FEDERATION HAS ARRIVED. $900,000 of pizza. 15% is a lot. The cap is $25,000. Hold the line.

name: FINAL BOSS: Audit Day
subtitle: Every rule. Three invoices. No mercy.
intro: The auditors are here. Three invoices. Every rule at once. If you mess this up, you're on dish duty until the heat death of the universe.
